description: Whether a combination of country, industry, company size and US state is covered, with the canonical names and a link to that search on the site. Use it for "do you have restaurant contacts in Germany" or "small businesses in Texas". Limitation: says covered or not; the number of matching records and the records themselves are shown on the site, not here.

company_size.description: Employee band such as "11-50", or a headcount such as "200"

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. Germany or DE

industry.description: Industry name, e.g. restaurants, dentists, hotels

us_state.description: US state name or code; only with country US

name: check_coverage
title: Check a filter combination
